last.summary: Merged origin/master (took origin/master's Oracle.lean and Oracle/Error.lean, as neither is owned by this task). The earlier work did not fit the new rules, so I also moved BitIO into namespace Bzip2.Oracle.BitIO (the names checks/oracle/bitio.lean opens), added doc strings and C citations (decompress.c:43-65, compress.c:73-78, compress.c:46-55, read before citing), moved the unit tests to tests/Bzip2/Test/BitIO.lean as #guards (byte-boundary reads, 32-bit reads, eof, write/read roundtrip of 3000 random widths), restored tests/Bzip2/Tests.lean to origin/master and removed a stray projects/out/result.json. Checked: `verify.sh && check-task.sh oracle/bitio` gives 'verify: packages/sources/build/style/axioms/lint/test: ok', 'verify: ok', 'check-task: oracle/bitio: ok'. `git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD` lists only oracle/Bzip2/Oracle/BitIO.lean and tests/Bzip2/Test/BitIO.lean; git status clean, nothing untracked.
